hints.title: Complement Search in Stateful Number Bags
hints.text: The structure accepts additions continuously while queries search for two existing integers summing to target.

hints.title: Frequency Counter Dictionary
hints.text: Maintain a frequency count of each added number. For each candidate number, the required partner is target minus candidate.

hints.title: Add and Find Operations Blueprint
hints.text: add(x) increments counts[x]. find(value) iterates over key in counts: complement = value - key; if complement == key, return counts[key] > 1; else if complement in counts, return true. Return false if no match.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) add, O(U) find where U is unique numbers
complexity.notes: O(1) hash table insertion and linear iteration over unique keys during search.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Precomputing all pairs during add takes quadratic O(N) per addition, exhausting memory for large insertions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Trade off O(U) find latency to achieve O(1) constant-time additions and compact memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Properly verifying that complement == num requires at least two occurrences.
